news.title: The stories behind the 2026 Fierce 50
news.summary: A Nobel laureate designing proteins from scratch. A public health expert who put retirement plans aside after the 2024 election to help protect vaccine policy and scientific independence. A physician working to make health information easier to understand and rebuild trust with patients. And a Native physician working to train more doctors who share the backgrounds and experiences of the communities they serve. In this episode of “Podnosis,” we tell the stories behind some of the 2026 Fierce 50 honorees and the work that put them on this year’s list.

papers.title: DiagEvo: Diagnosis-Guided Self-Evolution via Hierarchical Error Memory
papers.summary: Self-play is an effective paradigm for language-model self-evolution, but without guidance, solver performance can plateau or decline across rounds. Unguided methods steer question generation with signals such as difficulty, learnability, or diversity. These signals keep questions challenging and varied but do not specify which unresolved reasoning weaknesses later rounds should target.
